Name: Lepou Plugins - Lepou plugins bundle
Description: Drop-in VST DLLs organized into x32\ and x64\ subfolders. There is no vendor installer (no install.bat, .cmd, or .reg in the folder tree) and the plugin makes no system-level changes, so no junctions are created for it. Get the DLLs into a DAW-scanned directory by copying or hand-linking individual files.
